name: review-absence-detail-inline
body: The `searched at project root … on branch …` detail for a genuinely absent review target is built inline at the two absence sites — `apply_review_add`'s absent-target arm and `set_feedback_at`'s not-found bail — rather than through a shared helper, because the change-set declares no new production unit; each site is a three-line `repo_identity` lookup and the wording is pinned by one e2e test. Upgrade when a third absence site needs the same detail: extract one helper and route all of them through it.
